from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('/inputs/SKILL.md')
print('exists:', p.exists())
text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
print('bytes:', len(text.encode('utf-8')))
# show current name line(s)
for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
    if line.startswith('name:'):
        print(f'name_line_before:{i}:{line}')
        break
else:
    print('name_line_before:NOT_FOUND')

# targeted single replacement in-memory
new_text, n = re.subn(r'^name:\s*Command Development\s*$', 'name: command-development', text, count=1, flags=re.M)
print('replacement_count:', n)

# single targeted write attempt
try:
    if n == 1:
        p.write_text(new_text, encoding='utf-8')
        print('write_attempt:success')
    else:
        print('write_attempt:skipped_due_to_no_match')
except Exception as e:
    print('write_attempt:error')
    print(type(e).__name__ + ':', e)
